title: Diana M Possible NDE 6797
content: Thanks you for this opportunity. I cannot prove anything, but this is the truth. My mother was a religious zealot. I felt responsible for her illness after my twin sister's birth and me. She had tumors in her uterus, hemorrhaged, had experimental radiation, and was never well. After a rape at knife point and believing as I was taught that I lost my soul after losing my virginity I wanted to die. After my boyfriend was drafted, I had tried to get help, was misdiagnosed schizophrenic, sent to live in the basement of a nursing home, and was a zombie on heavy doses of medicine, which I was allergic to. I escaped but got drunk with friends and took the pills I had saved. I was taken to a clinic and passed out. Years later, I retrieved my experience under hypnosis. I was taken to an ethereal conference room filled with Angels, Light Beings, and Masters. The oval conference table was empty. Then a white piece of paper floated down. It was empty until letters began to appear one by one on the paper with spaces in between spelling T-R-U-T-H. I was escorted back to my body. The angels said they would protect me and asked that I tell the truth. I had no idea what truth to tell or what or who they would protect me from. I went on a spiritual journey to find new beliefs after leaving Catholicism. I was obsessed with writing. Shortly after, I dated an older man and became pregnant. I had a miscarriage and he murdered another girl on the playground where we had often made love. I had survival guilt again. I married an ex-convict, had a child and when I left him he tried to kill me for many years. He tried poison, arson, fire, and shooting. Afterwards I was obsessed with writing. I was protected through all of this. I was interested in healing after having energy work. I met someone, took her class, and joined her healing group. We were born at the same hospital on the same day, of the same year an hour apart and met forty years later. We are both authors and healers. I am a survivor of breast cancer after three years. A butterfly landed on my tumor before surgery and stayed there for an unearthly amount of time and I knew I still could not get out. My story is different in that I am not enlightened. I still get down. I am no guru and I did not want to be here. I am afraid now because my wonderful husband is a cancer survivor and I don't want to be without him. I have been obsessed with telling my story to give hope. I have prayed my story reaches those it will heal. I was not punished for suicide. Thank you. Love, Diana M
